program.name: Two-Split 60 Harder Moves II
program.subject: Signature
program.blurb: Two-Split 60 Harder Moves, one level harder: every day starts where the original's Level II did, with the newer moves in the mix.
program.about: The same two-day rhythm as Two-Split 60: upper body, then lower body, each finished with abs, in straight sets. Two-Split 60 moves you one weight up and then adds reps; this one changes the moves instead. At Levels II and III many exercises become their harder version, such as pull-ups for negatives, shrimp squats for split squats or single-leg deadlifts for dumbbell ones. This II is the same program one level up, with the newest moves in the mix, and its Level III adds a set where the day has room.
